articles.title: XRP ETFs pull in $170 million over eleven days. Goldman tops institutional holders
articles.description: Spot XRP funds have logged nine straight sessions of inflows, while Q2 filings show Goldman Sachs, Jane Street and Millennium among their biggest professional holders.

articles.title: A China indicator that supports risk-taking in stocks and bitcoin is flashing red
articles.description: China's "credit impulse" is flashing red for risk assets.So far, bitcoin has mostly shrugged it off.

articles.title: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help
articles.description: Astra is the first OpenAI model to reach its “Critical” cybersecurity threshold, meaning it can find previously unknown vulnerabilities and develop ways to exploit them across hardened systems.

articles.title: Solana, ether, xrp lead majors slide as Iran strikes drive a broad risk selloff
articles.description: Every large-cap token fell over the past 24 hours, and the high-beta majors gave up roughly triple what bitcoin did.

articles.title: Bitcoin withstands $90 oil and rising yields while gold slides. A firm dollar is the catch
articles.description: BTC trades choppy as $90 oil and rising bond yields weigh on stocks and gold.

articles.title: SEC proposes transfer agent rule, sets event to figure out round-the-clock U.S. trading
articles.description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued an agenda for its 24-trading roundtable and proposed a new transfer-agent rule with blockchain implications.

articles.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
articles.description: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

articles.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
articles.description: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.

articles.title: Musk’s X hit by wave of unsolicited password reset emails
articles.description: Multiple crypto industry figures and CoinDesk staff received unexpected password reset emails on Tuesday, though there is no evidence yet that X itself has been breached.

articles.title: Firelight raises $8 million, expands beyond XRP as it aims to make DeFi less scary for fintechs
articles.description: The protocol aims to give fintechs and investors a faster way to recover losses from DeFi hacks, while letting XRP, bitcoin and XLM holders earn yield by backing that protection.

articles.title: Bitcoin enters ‘Rektember’ as rate-hike risk combines with seasonality to threaten rally
articles.description: September has historically been a poor month for risk assets in general, and bitcoin, in particular.

articles.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
articles.description: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.

articles.title: UK’s crime agency freezes Premier League $13.5 million account in crypto crime probe
articles.description: Authorities targeted funds from a $140 million sponsorship deal with crypto firm Sorare, though law enforcement confirmed no wrongdoing by the Premier League.

articles.title: Hut 8's Texas power site sits inside Anthropic’s $35 billion AI deal
articles.description: The company's Texas campus has two long-term leases worth $19.6 billion, more than 260 times its latest quarterly revenue, as AI companies race to secure power and data-center capacity.

articles.title: U.S. looks to influence Japan's monetary policy. It couldn't do that with bitcoin
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 1, 2026

articles.title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
articles.description: The country’s financial watchdog says its proposed stablecoin rules are aligned with U.S. and EU frameworks and that it also paves the way for the recognition of foreign stablecoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $78,000 as Arbitrum surges 30% on Robinhood Chain revenue
articles.description: BTC drifted lower after last week's rally to $81,428, while ARB led DeFi gains as Robinhood Chain's daily fees topped $2 million.

articles.title: Strategy spends $635M buying back STRC as perpetual preferred stock lags $100 par
articles.description: STRC trades at $97.34 despite Strategy’s growing repurchases, while SATA’s higher dividend rate has helped it hold its $100 par value.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps as oil surges to three-month high on new Iran strikes
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs took in $217 million on Monday, one session after an outflow ended their nine-day run. Ether ETFs have not had net outflows since mid-August.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
articles.description: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.

articles.title: OpenAI’s ‘Trust Us’ TIME cover raises an old warning for AI bulls
articles.description: The magazine-cover indicator has a messy record, but TIME’s OpenAI cover checks the classic boxes: a mainstream publication, a widely understood theme and a multiyear run-up in investor enthusiasm.

articles.title: Bitcoin steady above $78,000, HYPE leads as majors slip on hawkish Fed bets
articles.description: Ether, solana, tron and dogecoin all shed ground over 24 hours while HYPE added about 4%, leaving bitcoin flat on the week after August's 24% run.

articles.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
articles.description: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

articles.title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
articles.description: Outstanding XRP futures positions outside CME fell by more than 500 million tokens in two weeks, while exposure on the regulated U.S. exchange climbed about 36% as XRP rallied toward $1.40.

articles.title: North Korean hackers are moving tens of millions on Hyperliquid as Trump pushes to onshore the crypto platform
articles.description: Blockchain data reviewed by CoinDesk shows wallets tied to North Korea’s Lazarus Group sold more than $30 million in bitcoin on the platform in the last three weeks alone.
